english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for accepting a claim, believing someone, or having confidence in someone.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 nei5 gong2 ge3 je5

english.note: Use this when expressing confidence that a proposition or situation is true.

exampleSentences.english: I trust that he’ll come back tomorrow.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 ting1 jat6 wui5 faan1 lai4

english.note: Use it when accept means believing that something is true.

exampleSentences.english: I accept that what they said is true.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 hai6 zan1 ge3
